g.text: Actual-world paired changes: output and inspection cost
Each comparison changes one factor relative to cautious procurement, communication on, capacity 32.
Track B · 30 paired heldout seeds per horizon · 240 fresh actual-world runs. Points are mean paired differences; bars are descriptive 95% seed-bootstrap intervals.
Fill uses actual delivered / required flour for three producing citizens. Credulous procurement detects fewer false reports; higher output is not universal information superiority.
